programs.title: Neighbors 2: Sorority Rising
programs.desc: Mac (Seth Rogen) and Kelly (Rose Byrne) Radner have decided to sell their house and move to a better neighborhood.They are thirty trial days away from finalizing the contract, during which time potential buyers can conduct an inspection and, if they don't like anything, break the contract.It's bad luck that students from the Kappa Nu sorority show up in the area.Shelby (Chloë Grace Moretz), Beth (Kiersey Clemons) and Nora (Beanie Feldstein) - just like their predecessors - love to throw parties.The Radners must enlist the help of their old enemy, Teddy Sanders (Zac Efron).The recent college star is struggling with his own issues.Lonely, he wants to be needed by someone at all costs.

programs.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programs.desc: Student Stefani (Kaitlyn Santa Juana) is plagued by nightmares about her grandparents.In their dreams, they die along with other people in the Skyview skyscraper in 1969.Although such an event never happened, the girl decides to investigate the cause of her visions.To do this, he returns to his hometown, Cloverdale.She is greeted there by her father, Marty (Tinpo Lee), and younger brother, Charlie (Teo Briones).Stefani begins searching for Iris (Brec Bassinger), the grandmother she sees in her nightmares and who has broken off contact with her family.To do this, he visits his Uncle Howard (Alex Zahara) and Aunt Brenda (April Telek).Thanks to the letters found among them, he reaches a woman (Gabrielle Rose) who is dying of cancer and lives in a remote area.She tells her that the skyscraper did not collapse only thanks to her vision and earlier intervention.At the same time, he warns that from that day on, death has haunted everyone who died in the disaster, and even the descendants of the would-be victims.As she dies, her words quickly come true.Stefani wants to save her relatives from the gruesome death that inevitably awaits them.The sixth installment of the series launched in 2000.

programs.title: Fault
programs.desc: Charismatic DJ Vika has always believed that age is a state of mind.She changed her approach when her health deteriorated.She realized that her goal could be to bring joy to other seniors.

programs.title: The Royal Hotel
programs.desc: Two American friends, Hanna (Julia Garner) and Liv (Jessica Henwick), decide to travel around Australia this summer.Unfortunately, at some point they run out of money.Women need to find temporary work.Their choice falls on a provincial mining settlement, where there is the only local bar called "The Royal Hotel".They quickly manage to adapt to the unusual atmosphere of this place, although this requires developing a specific strategy.Soon they are faced with a situation over which they lose control.

programs.title: Sarah Bernhardt, la divine
programs.desc: The beginning of the 20th century.The outstanding French actress Sarah Bernhardt (Sandrine Kiberlain) is considered one of the most important artists of her time and has the status of an international star.Her admirers include Oscar Wilde, Alfons Mucha and Victor Hugo.Her talent and extraordinary charisma, as well as her courage and extravagant lifestyle are widely admired.The actress disrupted social norms and shocked her contemporaries with her unusual preferences and numerous love affairs.She was a declared opponent of anti-Semitism.Fate connected her most closely with the actor Lucien Guitry (Laurent Lafitte) and the painter Louise Abbéma (Amira Casar).Since her unlucky fall on stage in 1905 in Rio de Janeiro, Divine Sarah has been struggling with terrible knee pain, which over the years has made it impossible for her to move.In order to be able to perform, after a decade, the actress makes a dramatic decision.Full of passion and inner strength, the artist will forever be remembered in the history of art and culture.

programs.title: Olivia and the Invisible Earthquake
programs.desc: Twelve-year-old Olivia, together with her younger brother Tim and her mother, must suddenly leave their current apartment and start all over again in a strange neighborhood.Wanting to protect Tim from fear and alleviate his sense of loss, the girl tells him that their move is part of the film in which he is the main character.This challenge to their imagination helps them come to terms with difficult reality.Over time, through new friendships, fun, and even a bit of magic, the siblings discover that they can truly take responsibility for their story.
